intro.text: An author of the Final Empire who held that a divine mandate could rest with common people and wasn't the Lord Ruler's alone.

items.text: At a ball in Fadrex City, Elend Venture told Aradan Yomen he preferred Gallingskaw's thinking on divine right to Durton's Calling of Trust. Yomen dismissed Gallingskaw as a heretic, saying that a truly logical thinker wouldn't have got himself executed.
